correctness.rationale: The exact two-transition finite chain and absorbing x=1 boundary are derived and independently enumerated. Fluid limit x/y-log(y/beta)=constant yields y*=beta exp(-alpha/beta); the bounded-jump martingale has predictable limiting variation [4-exp(-r)(r+2)^2]/y* and its small-x tail tends to zero, giving variance beta exp(-r)[4-exp(-r)(r+2)^2]. The derivative of the exact ratio proves its unique minimum at r=1. Exact checker and simulated diagnostics are supplementary, not proofs.

value.rationale: On a canonical dense graph family with a perfect matching at balanced sizes, uniform random-edge matching wastes a positive 1/(2e) fraction of optimal matching edges. A sharp family-wide worst aspect ratio and a closed Gaussian fluctuation variance make the precise inefficiency and finite-size uncertainty mathematically interpretable. The clique-clique edge channel creates the loss and distinguishes the model from complete bipartite matching.
